mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedule_execution ( execution_id, schedule_id, fire_key, trigger_source, scheduled_fire_time, actual_fire_time, completed_at, status, task_type, result_summary, safe_error_type, safe_error_message, executed_instance_id, created_at, updated_at, version ) VALUES ( #{execution.executionId}, #{execution.scheduleId}, #{execution.fireKey}, #{execution.triggerSource}, #{execution.scheduledFireTime}, #{execution.actualFireTime}, #{execution.completedAt}, #{execution.status}, #{execution.taskType}, #{execution.resultSummary}, #{execution.safeErrorType}, #{execution.safeErrorMessage}, #{execution.executedInstanceId}, #{execution.createdAt}, #{execution.updatedAt}, #{execution.version} ) ON CONFLICT (schedule_id, fire_key) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO schedule_execution ( execution_id, schedule_id, fire_key, trigger_source, scheduled_fire_time, actual_fire_time, completed_at, status, task_type, result_summary, safe_error_type, safe_error_message, executed_instance_id, created_at, updated_at, version ) VALUES ( #{execution.executionId}, #{execution.scheduleId}, #{execution.fireKey}, #{execution.triggerSource}, #{execution.scheduledFireTime}, #{execution.actualFireTime}, #{execution.completedAt}, #{execution.status}, #{execution.taskType}, #{execution.resultSummary}, #{execution.safeErrorType}, #{execution.safeErrorMessage}, #{execution.executedInstanceId}, #{execution.createdAt}, #{execution.updatedAt}, #{execution.version} ) ON CONFLICT (schedule_id, fire_key) DO UPDATE SET trigger_source = EXCLUDED.trigger_source, actual_fire_time = EXCLUDED.actual_fire_time, completed_at = EXCLUDED.completed_at, status = EXCLUDED.status, safe_error_type = EXCLUDED.safe_error_type, safe_error_message = EXCLUDED.safe_error_message, executed_instance_id = EXCLUDED.executed_instance_id, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at, version = schedule_execution.version + 1 WHERE schedule_execution.status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED', 'SKIPPED')
mapper.select: SELECT execution.* FROM schedule_execution execution INNER JOIN schedule_definition definition ON definition.id = execution.schedule_id WHERE execution.trigger_source = 'MANUAL' AND execution.status = 'PENDING' AND definition.deleted = 0 AND definition.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'PAUSED') ORDER BY execution.created_at, execution.execution_id
